title: DigiLocker Experiences Massive Expansion
text:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau

Ministry of Electronics & IT

DigiLocker Experiences Massive Expansion

Electricity Distribution utilities are now live for Millions of Consumers Nationwide

Posted On:
10 JUN 2026 9:15PM by PIB Delhi

DigiLocker, India’s flagship digital document wallet under the Digital India programme, has successfully onboarded 68 Electricity Distribution Companies (DISCOMs) and Power

Departments across the country.

This major integration allows electricity consumers across 35 States and Union Territories to securely access their digital electricity bills directly within the DigiLocker app, bringing greater convenience, accessibility and efficiency in the management of essential utility documents. The participating entities include state power distribution companies, municipal electricity departments and private distribution utilities, serving millions of consumers nationwide.

By making electricity bills available through DigiLocker, consumers can retrieve their latest bills

digitally whenever required, eliminating the need to search through emails, maintain physical copies or visit service provider offices. The integration ensures that consumers have access to

issuer-sourced documents from their respective electricity service providers through a secure and trusted platform.

To view a step-by-step video guide on
How to access your Electricity Bill on Digilocker
,
Click here:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=s8zl_kK_1sk

Prominent public and private utilities now live on Digilocker:

1. Dhakshinachal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Limited

2. Madhyanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Limited

3. Paschimanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Limited

4. Bangalore Electricity Supply Company Limited

5. Dakshin Haryana Bijli Vitran Nigam

6. Jharkhand Bijli Vitran Nigam Limited

7. BSES Rajdhani Power Limited

8. BSES Yamuna Power Limited

9. Chandigarh Power Distribution Limited

10. Noida Power Company Limited and others.

Strengthening India’s Digital Utility Ecosystem

The on-boarding of 68 electricity utilities marks a significant milestone in DigiLocker’s efforts to make essential citizen documents readily accessible through a secure digital platform. As DigiLocker expands its ecosystem of trusted issuers, citizens will benefit from simplified access to government and utility-issued credentials while organisations will benefit from streamlined digital service delivery.



****

Dharmendra Tewari / Dr. Nayan Solanki / Kanishk Sharma

(Release ID: 2271375)
